body:
The RC slowdown investigation now has 76 successful fresh-worker measurements (380 samples) from the reference EC2 host. The evidence validates Clifft #655 against its exact parent, reproduces the published Draper loss, and records the unresolved d5 preparation-history effect without changing benchmark code or release figures.

- Matched parent/patch Draper: +10.505% in ABBA and +9.726% in BAAB; d3 noisy controls remain within the 1.1% inconclusive band.
- Published previous/RC Draper: -4.220% / -4.046%. The source parent is ~10.9% slower than the same-commit wheel, so the patch gain is not a forecast of the next wheel's result.
- d3: original loss does not reproduce; fixed batches and full calibration give +1.144% to +2.731%.
- d5: fixed-b1 blocks give -5.160% / -7.137%, while full-calibration blocks give +4.404% / +6.132%, all selecting batch 1. Fresh-worker variability remains substantial; this does not clear the release regression question.

The evidence directory includes raw JSON/CSV for every worker, exact package/build identities, input snapshots, calibration history, the captured temporary scripts in an archive, and a review-only figure showing independent-worker medians. Built wheels remain in the durable local backup with hashes in the PR. The original campaign stays in #100; this PR does not depend on merging it.

Validation: all 76 raw documents pass the pinned harness; all 76 CSV files regenerate byte-for-byte; all correctness, seed, duration, count, affinity/thread/memory checks pass; 170 remote files matched local SHA256 before shutdown; all 168 published original files/archive members match those hashes; README links and `git diff --check` pass. Maximum within-worker relative MAD is 0.4994%, peak RSS 98.05 MiB. The figure was visually reviewed. No maintained Python code changed.

The host accepted `sudo shutdown -h now` at 05:18:19 UTC after retrieval, and subsequently became unreachable over SSH. Shutdown behavior is Stop as confirmed by the user; AWS API stopped state could not be independently confirmed because the existing CLI session expired.

Related: https://github.com/unitaryfoundation/clifft/issues/656 and https://github.com/unitaryfoundation/clifft/pull/655. Keep #656 open for the unresolved d5/release-artifact questions.
title: Record reference-host RC regression and patch validation
